name: Chatbase
tagline: Chatbase lets anyone build a custom AI chatbot trained on their own documents, website, PDFs, or Notion pages — no code required. The resulting chatbot can be embedded on a website, connected to Slack or WhatsApp, or accessed via API. Businesses use it for customer support, lead capture, and internal knowledge bases, replacing FAQ pages with a conversational interface powered by their own content. Chatbase became one of the fastest-growing AI SaaS products of 2023, reaching $1M ARR within months of launch.
